description: Combined wind and tide forecast verification dashboard. Compares wind speed/direction and tide forecasts against observations. Bias, MAE, RMSE, ensemble coverage, lead-time diagnostics, and forecast skill metrics. Internal use only. Primary target: Victoria.

panels.description: Status checks for forecast horizon, tide observations, wind observations, and tide verification freshness.

targets.rawSql:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = '$group' AND locname = '$location' AND model = 'tide_nbm' AND tidemean IS NOT NULL) AS latest_tide_forecast,
    (SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = '$group' AND locname = '$location' AND model = 'tide_nbm' AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL) AS latest_wind_forecast,
    (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = '$group' AND locname = '$location' AND model = 'tide_astro' AND prelimtide IS NOT NULL) AS latest_tide_observation,
    (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = '$group' AND locname = '$location' AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL) AS latest_wind_speed_observation,
    (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM public.v_forecast_verification WHERE variable = 'tide' AND group_id = '$group' AND locname = '$location') AS latest_tide_verification
)
SELECT 'Tide forecast horizon' AS "Check",
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_forecast >= NOW() THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status",
       latest_tide_forecast AS "Timestamp",
       latest_tide_forecast - NOW() AS "Lead/Lag"
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Wind forecast horizon',
       CASE WHEN latest_wind_forecast >= NOW() THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE' END,
       latest_wind_forecast,
       latest_wind_forecast - NOW()
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tide observations',
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_observation >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE/MISSING' END,
       latest_tide_observation,
       NOW() - latest_tide_observation
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Wind observations',
       CASE WHEN latest_wind_speed_observation IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' WHEN latest_wind_speed_observation >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE' END,
       latest_wind_speed_observation,
       CASE WHEN latest_wind_speed_observation IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW() - latest_wind_speed_observation END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tide verification data',
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_verification >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE/MISSING' END,
       latest_tide_verification,
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_verification IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW() - latest_tide_verification END
FROM metrics

panels.title: Forecast & Observation Freshness

panels.description: Shows which observation feeds currently populate this group/location.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Wind speed observations' AS "Observation",
       COUNT(*) AS "Rows",
       MAX(timestamp) AS "Latest timestamp",
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'No obs_wspd_kt rows for this group/location' ELSE 'Available' END AS "Status"
FROM public.forecast_data
WHERE group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Wind direction observations',
       COUNT(*),
       MAX(timestamp),
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'No obs_wdir_degrees rows for this group/location' ELSE 'Available' END
FROM public.forecast_data
WHERE group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tide preliminary observations',
       COUNT(*),
       MAX(timestamp),
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'No prelimtide rows' ELSE 'Available' END
FROM public.forecast_data
WHERE group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND prelimtide IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Observation Availability
Wind speed metrics
panels.description: Bias = AVG(forecast - observed); MAE = AVG(abs(error)); RMSE = sqrt(AVG(error^2)); In-envelope = observations between windspdlb and windspdub. 'Ensemble mean' uses windspdmean; 'NBM' uses windspd. Observations sourced from obs_wspd_kt on model_1 fhr=0 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
      ELSE '72h+'
    END AS lead_bucket,
    f.windspdmean AS forecast_mean,
    f.windspd     AS forecast_nbm,
    f.windspdlb   AS forecast_lb,
    f.windspdub   AS forecast_ub,
    o.obs_wspd_kt AS observed_value
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
), errors AS (
  SELECT lead_bucket,
         observed_value,
         forecast_lb, forecast_ub,
         forecast_mean - observed_value AS err_mean,
         forecast_nbm  - observed_value AS err_nbm
  FROM matched
  WHERE observed_value IS NOT NULL
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
)
SELECT 'Ensemble mean' AS "Source",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_mean IS NOT NULL) AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                    AS "Bias (kt)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))               AS "MAE (kt)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean))   AS "RMSE (kt)",
       AVG(CASE WHEN observed_value BETWEEN forecast_lb AND forecast_ub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE forecast_lb IS NOT NULL) AS "In-envelope"
FROM errors
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NBM',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_nbm IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_nbm),
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_nbm * err_nbm)),
       NULL::float
FROM errors

panels.title: Wind direction metrics
panels.description: Direction error uses shortest signed angular difference, so +/-180 deg is the largest possible miss. 'Ensemble mean' uses winddirmean; 'NBM' uses winddir. Observations sourced from obs_wdir_degrees on model_1 fhr=0 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
      ELSE '72h+'
    END AS lead_bucket,
    f.winddirmean AS forecast_mean,
    f.winddir     AS forecast_nbm,
    o.obs_wdir_degrees AS observed_value
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wdir_degrees
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.winddirmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
), errors AS (
  SELECT lead_bucket,
         (MOD((forecast_mean - observed_value + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float AS err_mean,
         (MOD((forecast_nbm  - observed_value + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float AS err_nbm
  FROM matched
  WHERE observed_value IS NOT NULL
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
)
SELECT 'Ensemble mean' AS "Source",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_mean IS NOT NULL) AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                  AS "Circular bias (deg)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))             AS "MAE (deg)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean)) AS "RMSE (deg)"
FROM errors
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NBM',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_nbm IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_nbm),
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_nbm * err_nbm))
FROM errors

panels.title: Daily wind speed Bias and MAE

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT f."timestamp",
         CASE
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
           ELSE '72h+'
         END AS lead_bucket,
         f.windspdmean - o.obs_wspd_kt AS err_mean,
         f.windspd     - o.obs_wspd_kt AS err_nbm
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND o.obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       AVG(err_mean)        AS "Bias (mean)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))   AS "MAE (mean)",
       AVG(err_nbm)         AS "Bias (NBM)",
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm))    AS "MAE (NBM)"
FROM matched
WHERE lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind speed MAE by lead-time bucket

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
           ELSE '72h+'
         END AS lead_bucket,
         f.windspdmean - COALESCE(o.obs_wspd_kt, o.windspd, f.windspd) AS error
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt, o.obs_wdir_degrees, o.windspd, o.winddir
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.obs_wspd_kt, o.windspd, f.windspd) IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
)
SELECT lead_bucket, AVG(ABS(error)) AS mae
FROM matched
WHERE lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

WITH matched AS (

         CASE
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'

         f.windspdmean AS "Forecast (mean)",
         f.windspd     AS "Forecast (NBM)",
         o.obs_wspd_kt AS "Observed",
         f.windspdlb   AS "Wind speed (lower bound)",

  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (

    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname

      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)

    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL

    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")

FROM matched
WHERE "Observed" IS NOT NULL
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
ORDER BY "time"

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT f."timestamp" AS "time",
         CASE
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
           ELSE '72h+'
         END AS lead_bucket,
         f.winddirmean AS "Forecast (mean)",
         f.winddir     AS "Forecast (NBM)",
         o.obs_wdir_degrees AS "Observed"
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wdir_degrees
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.winddirmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
), src AS (
  SELECT "time", "Forecast (mean)", "Forecast (NBM)", "Observed"
  FROM matched
  WHERE "Observed" IS NOT NULL
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
)
SELECT w."time",
       w.v1_s0 AS "Forecast (mean)", w.v1_sm1 AS "Forecast (mean)_sm1", w.v1_sp1 AS "Forecast (mean)_sp1",
       w.v2_s0 AS "Forecast (NBM)", w.v2_sm1 AS "Forecast (NBM)_sm1", w.v2_sp1 AS "Forecast (NBM)_sp1",
       w.v3_s0 AS "Observed", w.v3_sm1 AS "Observed_sm1", w.v3_sp1 AS "Observed_sp1"
FROM public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg("Forecast (mean)" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg("Forecast (NBM)" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg("Observed" ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w
ORDER BY w."time"

panels.title: Matched sample count by lead bucket (wind)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
           ELSE '72h+'
         END AS lead_bucket,
         COALESCE(o.obs_wspd_kt, o.windspd, f.windspd) AS speed_obs,
         COALESCE(o.obs_wdir_degrees, o.winddir, f.winddir) AS direction_obs
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt, o.obs_wdir_degrees, o.windspd, o.winddir
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$wind_model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
)
SELECT lead_bucket AS "Lead bucket",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed_obs IS NOT NULL) AS "Wind speed pairs",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_obs IS NOT NULL) AS "Wind direction pairs"
FROM base
WHERE lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Verification metrics by model
panels.description: Bias = AVG(forecast − observed); MAE = AVG(|err|); RMSE = sqrt(AVG(err²)); In-env = fraction of observations inside the ensemble bounds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*)                              AS "N",
       AVG(error * 0.3048)                   AS "Bias (m)",
       AVG(ABS(error) * 0.3048)              AS "MAE (m)",
       SQRT(AVG(error*error)) * 0.3048       AS "RMSE (m)",
       AVG(in_envelope::float) FILTER (WHERE forecast_lb IS NOT NULL) AS "In-envelope"
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model

SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       model AS metric,
       AVG(ABS(error) * 0.3048) AS mae
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       model AS metric,
       AVG(error * 0.3048) AS bias
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT lead_bucket,
       AVG(ABS(error) * 0.3048)::float AS mae
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND model = '$tide_model'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN 'astro' THEN -1 WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Forecast vs Observed (scatter) — $tide_model
panels.description: Each point is a matched (forecast, observation) pair for the selected tide model. Perfect forecasts fall on the y=x diagonal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_value_display * 0.3048 AS observed_value, forecast_value_display * 0.3048 AS forecast_value
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND model = '$tide_model'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

WITH r AS (
  SELECT LEAST(MIN(observed_value_display), MIN(forecast_value_display)) * 0.3048 AS mn,
         GREATEST(MAX(observed_value_display), MAX(forecast_value_display)) * 0.3048 AS mx
  FROM v_forecast_verification
  WHERE variable = 'tide'
    AND model = '$tide_model'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
)
SELECT g::float AS identity_x, g::float AS identity_y
FROM r, generate_series(r.mn::numeric, r.mx::numeric, GREATEST((r.mx - r.mn) / 100.0, 0.01)::numeric) g

panels.description: Detects unusually large forecast-time gaps by model/run.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT model,
         forecastdtutc,
         forecastdtutc - LAG(forecastdtutc) OVER (PARTITION BY model, startdt ORDER BY forecastdtutc) AS gap
  FROM public.forecast_data
  WHERE group_id = '$group'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND model IN ('tide_nbm', 'wind_nbm', 'tide_astro')
    AND (tidemean IS NOT NULL OR windspdmean IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gap > INTERVAL '1 hour 30 minutes') AS "Gaps > 90 min",
       MAX(gap) AS "Largest gap",
       MIN(forecastdtutc) AS "First forecast",
       MAX(forecastdtutc) AS "Last forecast"
FROM ordered
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model

SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*) AS "Rows",
       COUNT(DISTINCT startdt) AS "Runs",
       MAX(startdt) AS "Latest startdt",
       MIN(forecastdtutc) AS "First forecast time",
       MAX(forecastdtutc) AS "Last forecast time",
       MAX(created_at) AS "Latest ingest"
FROM public.forecast_data
WHERE group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND (tidemean IS NOT NULL OR windspdmean IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model
